body:
I'm personally not a big fan of having flags that can be in strange states. I would consider any state for which `double_click && triple_click != false` invalid.

Maybe we can encode this in a way that only allows valid states? E.g. an enum `selection.selection_mode=SelectionMode::SINGLE_CLICK, SelectionMode::DOUBLE_CLICK, SelectionMode::TRIPPLE_CLICK`
Is it expected to copy selected text on triple click?

On Linux X11/Wayland, anything that's selected is put in the "primary" keyboard, which can be pasted with middle mouse click. That's what this refers to here (`clipboard_set_primary`). So I think that's correct.

Testing on Firefox, double click (word selection) and triple click (paragraph selection) both get added to the primary clipboard.
